_comment: Named address ranges of the Crackdown (v1.0, default.xex) image for the inventory. kind: library = statically linked SDK / middleware, replaced as a unit by Any360 (not decompiled); game = the title's own code (decompiled at stage 2). Evidence: HLE_RENDERER_PLAN.md (D3D runtime range, entry points), src/crt_native.cpp and the __savegprlr helpers at 0x82ABDxxx, the import thunks in generated crackdown_init.cpp (0x82B67xxx). Ranges outside the list are reported by 1 MB area until symbol recovery (stage 2) names them.
